newsitem.title: USA: Washington Gas files $193 mln shelf notes.
newsitem.headline: Washington Gas files $193 mln shelf notes.

text.p: Washington Gas Light Co said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $193 million in unsecured notes.
When combined with a previous registration, Washington will have a total offering of $250 million of unsecured notes available for sale, the filing said.

Proceeds will be used for refunding of maturing long-term debt and satisfaction of sinking fund requirements, the refunding of higher-coupon long-term debt as market conditions permit and for general corporate purposes.
The Washington, D.C. based company is a public utility that delivers and sells natural gas to the metropolitian Washington area and adjoining areas in Maryland and Virginia.
